in_sanskrit.long_meaning: कृ (to do) + ता (that) + न् (in) + जलि (offering, presentation)

in_hindi.meaning: कृत (करना - to do) + आंजलि (आञ्जलि - offering, presentation)

in_tamil.name: கிருதந்தாஜலி

in_marathi.name: Kritanjali
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Pledge of Love
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kritanjali हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Krita signifies 'praise' or 'done'. Anjali means 'offering' or 'pledge'. This name symbolizes the love and devotion offered to the divine.

in_bengali.long_meaning: Kritanjali একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Krita signifies 'praise' or 'done'. Anjali means 'offering' or 'pledge'. This name symbolizes the love and devotion offered to the divine.
